mapper.select: SELECT pt.TERMS_ID as termsId, pt.TERMS_CODE as termsCode, pt.TERMS_NAME as termsName, pt.SUPPLIER_ID as supplierId, s.SUPPLIER_NAME as supplierName, pt.PAYMENT_DAYS as paymentDays, pt.DISCOUNT_DAYS as discountDays, pt.DISCOUNT_RATE as discountRate, pt.STATUS as status, pt.BOOK_ID as bookId, pt.TENANT_ID as tenantId, pt.CREATE_TIME as createTime, pt.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, pt.CREATOR as creator, pt.UPDATER as updater, pt.REMARK as remark, pt.VERSION as version FROM T_PAYMENT_TERMS pt LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON s.SUPPLIER_ID = pt.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE pt.IS_DELETED = 0 AND pt.TERMS_ID = #{termsId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
